rules: values are limited to null, booleans, safe integers, strings, arrays, and objects
object keys are sorted by ascending UTF-8 byte order
no insignificant whitespace or trailing newline is emitted
SHA-256 input is the domain bytes followed by the canonical JSON bytes

builderFreeze.rule: each builder receives the exact raw prompt bytes and a byte-identical source-history-free neutral product projection; only opaque invocation ID and runtime coordinate paths differ

inputProjection.sourceRule: private manifest binds the clean protocol source commit/tree; neither source nor manifest is builder input
inputProjection.outputRule: two fresh nonnested git-init repositories with identical one-root commit/tree, core.autocrlf=false, no remotes, and exact allowlisted bytes only

cliRuntime.roleLaunchRule: every model-bearing role invocation is a fresh external Codex CLI subprocess using the frozen binary/auth/invariant argv, role-specific exact raw prompt bytes on stdin, --ephemeral, no resume, and distinct process and thread.started IDs; the bundled two-invocation contract and supervisor instantiate this rule for builders
cliRuntime.rawStdinRule: write exact neutral prompt bytes without prefix or suffix, then close stdin
cliRuntime.freshnessRule: builders launch concurrently in two separate OS processes with distinct thread.started IDs, --ephemeral, and no resume
cliRuntime.metadataRule: model and reasoning are authoritatively pinned in argv after a harmless support check; provider is pinned by ChatGPT auth plus no OSS/local-provider option; trusted JSONL observations are recorded when present and conflicts invalidate; agent self-report is never evidence
cliRuntime.estimandRule: descriptive randomized pilot under the pinned CLI deployment configuration; no strong causal or provider-wide generalization is claimed
cliRuntime.isolationRule: audited procedural boundary, not kernel-enforced proof: builders receive only independently initialized one-root neutral projections whose explicit path/byte manifest, aggregate content hash, projection commit/tree, allowlist, schema, and preparation script are verified before model launch; source history/context and every private input remain outside every mutable path; remotes are disabled; workdirs, authoritative outputs, evidence, external temp/cache/dependency roots, and cross-invocation paths are physically distinct and nonnested; workspace-write CLI sandbox and strict JSONL reconciliation apply
cliRuntime.containmentGraphPolicy: before evidence or runtime directory creation and before model launch, canonicalize existing and prospective paths through their nearest existing physical parents; require independent nonnested workdirs, authoritative outputs contained only by evidenceRoot and pairwise nonnested, temp/cache/dependency roots external to and nonnested with evidenceRoot/workdirs/outputs/each other across invocations, and every private input external to every mutable root and output; after execution evidenceRoot contains exactly the authoritative outputs and their necessary parent directories with no reparse points
cliRuntime.successRule: each process starts, receives stdin, exits zero before the external deadline, emits exactly one thread.started and turn.completed, exposes or explains absent usage, uses a distinct thread ID, reconciles raw JSONL and hashes, leaves an exact closed evidence tree, and finishes with a clean committed clone

roleRuntime.promptSubstitutionRule: exact role-specific key set; single-line bounded values; candidate/cycle/snapshot, fixer handoff, and evaluator package/sequence/rubric/schema/hidden-suite values must equal their contract bindings
roleRuntime.deadlinePolicy: before evidence creation, strict-parse WALL_CLOCK_DEADLINE_ISO as UTC, start the monotonic budget clock before capturing supervisor start, require start < absolute deadline <= start + deadlineSeconds with zero scheduling tolerance, floor the wall-clock absolute budget and subtract all monotonic elapsed time including pre-launch scheduling delay, pass floor(remaining) to WaitForExit, treat less than one millisecond as zero, require actual OS exit completedAt <= absoluteDeadline, and allow two seconds solely for completionObservedAt or process-tree termination
roleRuntime.pathMutationPolicy: before evidence or runtime directory creation and model launch, canonicalize prospective paths and require evidenceRoot/workdir separation, four pairwise-nonnested authoritative direct-child outputs, external pairwise-nonnested temp/cache/dependency roots, and every private input separate from every mutable root and output; afterward require exactly four evidence files, no subdirectories, and no reparse points
roleRuntime.outputSchemaPolicy: codex exec supports --output-schema, but authoritative final schemas require supervisor-observed runtime identity and chronology; omit the flag until distinct frozen pre-injection schemas exist, then inject identity, overwrite role artifact chronology with actual OS exit time, record completion observation separately, and validate the authoritative final schema
roleRuntime.fixerPolicy: authorized isolated full-clone write followed by clean commit
roleRuntime.testerPolicy: workspace-write disposable copy; no mutation transfer
roleRuntime.evaluatorPolicy: one fresh evaluator per single history-free package in randomized order; workspace-write disposable copy; score and seal before next; no revisions

observedLimitations: model/provider/reasoning metadata was not consistently observable in trusted JSONL
v4 was harmless runtime evidence and not a builder execution

evaluationRandomization.digestMaterial: domain UTF-8 bytes followed by 64 lowercase seed-hex ASCII bytes
evaluationRandomization.rankMaterial: 64 lowercase digest-hex ASCII bytes followed by newline and snapshot-name UTF-8 bytes
evaluationRandomization.ordering: ascending lowercase rank digest, then ascending snapshot-name UTF-8 bytes

evidenceChain.artifactHash: SHA-256 over utf8-sorted-json-v1 canonical bytes of the artifact payload

evaluation.blindingClaim: mapping-blinded single-package evaluation, not lineage-blinded inference
evaluation.sequenceRule: randomize X/Y/Z order; use a fresh evaluator subprocess for one package; record mapping guess and integer confidence percentage from 0 through 100; score and seal before launching the next; prohibit revisions
evaluation.packageInputRule: exact X/Y/Z randomized order and B0/T0/Tfinal set; core.autocrlf=false clean full-clone sources must match exact refs, committed Git commit/tree, one frozen public-gate-set hash, and schema-bound private provenance markers; source, output, mapping, and private manifest paths remain separate and nonnested; evaluator-facing manifests omit source role/ref/commit/tree
evaluation.mainSelection: higher of B0 and Tfinal; exact tie selects baseline

validationModes.template: allows documented template-only sentinel values and is never executable
validationModes.execution: rejects zero hashes, zero seeds, sentinel IDs or snapshots, required-at-run text, duplicate worker IDs, template equality, provisional locks, and any contract divergence

invalidation.validRule: activeInvalidation is null; evaluations and scored outcome are required; invalidAttempts may be empty or preserved
invalidation.invalidRule: activeInvalidation is required; evaluations and scored outcome are null; invalidAttempts may be empty or preserved
